description: Count calendar days from start to end. Both are YYYY-MM-DD. include_start and include_end default to false, so the count is the dates strictly after start and strictly before end: 2024-02-28 to 2024-03-01 is 1 in a leap year (29 February) and 0 in a common year. Set both to true to count every date from start through end (3 in that leap-year span, 2 otherwise). The count is negative when end is before start. The same day is 0 unless both ends are included, which is 1. The result is that count and nothing else.
name: days_between

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.
